title: Both status and the throne room's own 'weigh the doors' text advertise 'burn it with Ironbound oil' as a valid ending, and I was carrying 'a cask of Ironbound oil (meant for burning a hollow clean)' at the time, but the action menu at The Hollow Throne only ever offered 'sit the throne, wearing the Vale's crown' and the kneel trap — no burn option ever appeared.
where: The Hollow Throne / weigh the doors of the seat

evidence.quote: Both status and the throne room's own 'weigh the doors' text advertise 'burn it with Ironbound oil' as a valid ending, and I was carrying 'a cask of Ironbound oil (meant for burning a hollow clean)' at the time, but the action menu at The Hollow Throne only ever offered 'sit the throne, wearing the Vale's crown' and the kneel trap — no burn option ever appeared.
